sn54.15:1.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā || pe || ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || || 3.
sn54.15:1.2: Atthi nu kho bhante eko dhammo bhā- bahucattāro dhamme paripūreti || cattāro dhammā bhā- bahusatta dhamme paripūrenti || satta dhammā bhā- bahudve dhamme paripūrentī ti || ||
sn54.15:1.3: Atthi kho bhikkhave eko dhammo bhā- bahu- cattāro dhamme paripūreti || cattāro dhammā bhā- bahu- satta dhamme paripūrenti || satta dhammā bhā- bahu- dve dhamme paripūrentī ti || || 4.
sn54.15:2.1: Katamo pana bhante eko dhammo bhā- bahu- cattāro dhamme paripūreti || cattāro dhammā bhā- bahu- satta dhamme paripūrenti || satta dhammā bhā- bahu- dve dhamme paripūrentīti || ||
sn54.15:2.2: Ānāpānasatisamādhi kho bhikkhave eko dhammo bhābahu- cattāro satipaṭṭhāne paripūreti || cattāro satipaṭṭhānā bhā- bahu- sattabojjhaṅge paripūrenti || sattabojjhaṅgā bhābahu- vijjāvimuttim paripūrenti || || 5.
sn54.15:3.1: Katham bhāvito ca bhikkhave ānāpānāsatisamādhi katham bahulīkato cattāro satipaṭṭhāne paripūreti || || 6--34.
sn54.15:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā || la || || 35.
sn54.15:3.3: Evam bhāvitā kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā evam bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttim paripūrentī
